zh.name: 偷鸡的瓦棚
zh.description: 一只小黄鼠狼精，躲在瓦搭的棚子里啃鸡腿。
zh.teachingFocus: 往后拉，松手。瓦一碰就碎。

en.name: Chicken Thief's Shed
en.description: One little weasel in a shed of roof tiles, gnawing a drumstick.
en.teachingFocus: Pull back and let go. Tiles shatter at a touch.

zh.name: 柴门木屋
zh.description: 三只躲在木屋里。木头结实，要快。
zh.teachingFocus: 短飞剑：飞行中点一下，直冲出去，木头一穿就透。

en.name: The Log Cabin
en.description: Three hide in a cabin of logs. Wood is tough: be quick.
en.teachingFocus: Flying sword: tap in flight and it shoots straight on, through wood.

zh.name: 瓦楼
zh.description: 两层瓦楼，上下各藏一只。
zh.teachingFocus: 陶罐：飞行中点一下，碎成三块，各砸各的。

en.name: The Tile Tower
en.description: A two-storey tile tower, one weasel up, one down.
en.teachingFocus: Clay pot: tap in flight and it breaks into three.

zh.name: 火药房
zh.description: 三座木楼，中间垫着火药桶。
zh.teachingFocus: 五雷符：一碰就炸；点燃一个火药桶，连着一串都炸。

en.name: The Powder Store
en.description: Three wooden towers with powder kegs between them.
en.teachingFocus: Thunder talisman: it bursts on a strike. Light one keg and the chain goes up.

zh.name: 大王寨
zh.description: 黄鼠狼大王坐在寨顶，石头、铁、瓦，一层一层。
zh.teachingFocus: 从上往下拆：先砸塌顶上的大王。

en.name: The Chief's Keep
en.description: The weasel chief sits on top: stone, iron and tile, layer on layer.
en.teachingFocus: Work from the top: bring the chief down first.

zh.name: 射鹿
zh.description: 溪边，那头雄鹿低着头喝水。
zh.teachingFocus: 先看风，后看鹿。擦着它过去，它就跑了。

en.name: The Stag
en.description: By the stream the stag drinks, head down.
en.teachingFocus: Wind first, then the deer. Graze it and it bolts.

zh.name: 暗河里那一团红光
zh.description: 干了的暗河，黑里蹲着邹青松，葫芦塞着。黑里射不着人。
zh.teachingFocus: 先往黑里丢一块石子——葫芦一开，就有光。再一箭奔那团红光。

en.name: The Red Light in the Dark
en.description: The dry river under the mountain: Zou Qingsong crouched in the dark, his gourd stoppered. You can't shoot a man in the dark.
en.teachingFocus: A stone into the dark first: open the gourd and there is light. Then the arrow at the red light.

zh.name: 芦苇里那一等
zh.description: 沂水滩上，鯥叫荆棘钉住了。皮厚，刀剑不入。
zh.teachingFocus: 等它吸气——翅膀根翻开的那一霎。飞行中点一下，剑直冲出去。

en.name: The Wait in the Reeds
en.description: On the Yi shoal the lu is caught in the brambles. Its hide turns a blade.
en.teachingFocus: Wait for its breath: the instant the wing root opens. Tap in flight and the sword flies straight.

zh.name: 你投一个给我看看
zh.description: 百团大战，校篮球队的摊子。「你投一个给我看看。」
zh.teachingFocus: 越过篮筐，越过篮板——马小宝的摇杯在后头那张桌上。

en.name: Throw One for Me
en.description: The club fair, the basketball team's stall. "Throw one for me."
en.teachingFocus: Over the rim, over the backboard: Ma Xiaobao's shaker is on the table behind.

zh.name: 讲堂试法
zh.description: 「手是沟，咒是赶水的人。」讲堂后头立着一排草人。
zh.teachingFocus: 扔一回，丹田便空一截——四层，四回。火弹落地就炸；冰锥、金刃飞行中点一下。

en.name: Trying the Spells
en.description: "The hand is the ditch; the chant drives the water." At the back of the lecture hall stands a row of straw dummies.
en.teachingFocus: Each throw empties the dantian a notch: fourth layer, four throws. The fireball bursts where it strikes; tap the ice spike or the gold blade in flight.
